subject: W7 System-pane disclosure completed: health/gateway/workcell/adapters as PR #292 (stacked on #290)
result: Continued W7 past the credential producer (#290). The System pane now discloses the whole installation, through the same boundary seam. PR #292 (base = agent/wave7-system-producer, stacked on #290) carries two commits. (2) workcell/adapters: wired the previously-uncalled aikit_adapters intake_workcell_instances via WorkcellDisclosure + Service::workcell_world() (cached), replacing the Workcell placeholder; the Adapters row is a roll-call synthesised from the git/secret/workcell provider disclosures already on the reading. Every disclosure keeps nobody-looked (NotAttempted) distinct from unavailable and from observed-empty. Verified on the real machine: Health reads 0 error/18 warning/5 note with Gateway not running; Workcell reads unavailable because the installed workcell predates the instances protocol (a real finding a fixture would hide). Full cargo test -p aikit-core -p aikit-tui -p aikit-cli green; clippy clean. Remaining W7, all one interactive cluster (action-lane, not disclosure): reaching the credential-setup panel and the model-roster matrix from inside the running palette, and applying a doctor repair from there — a new Overlay/UiAction plus interactive secret entry in the event loop.
